svg.title: From text to search: who creates vectors
svg.desc: The example uses dimension 3, so both write and query use [1,0,0]; identical cosine vectors score about 1. An application or AI embedding model supplies real vectors. Search returns matches and scores, not generated answers or percentages.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["Document text"] B["Application / AI embedding: create vectors"] C["VecDB: store equal-dimension vectors and document metadata"] D["Query text"] E["Same model: create the query vector"] F["VecDB: search with filters, topK and score constraints"] G["Return matching documents and scores"] A --> B B --> C D --> E E --> F C --> F F --> G classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class G good;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif

svg.text: From text to search: who creates vectors
